notes.subject: Lesin, ol man bilong mi
notes.rationale: God i singautim ol man bilong en long lesin — pasin olsem 'Sapta, Yisrael'.

notes.subject: ol man bilong mi / Yisrael
notes.rationale: Tok i go stret long Yisrael, ol man bilong Yahwe.

notes.subject: ואעידה בך
notes.rationale: 'mi givim tok bilong witness long yu' — samting i go long yu (kontrak) o i go gens long yu (kot); KJV/JPS i tingting gens, ASV i tingting long.

translation: Lesin, ol man bilong mi, na bai mi tok; Yisrael, na bai mi givim tok bilong witness ⟨long⟩ yu: Elohim, Elohim bilong yu, em ⟨na⟩ mi.

tokens.gloss: na bai mi givim tok bilong witness
